line: before you start, my sign is 'skeptical with a rising eyebrow'. do your worst.

ha. okay. um. what's eating me. mostly the parking situation at this festival. brutal. ...fine, and maybe the fact that i got offered my dream job in another city and i keep making jokes about it instead of deciding.
my girlfriend says i'd deflect my own funeral. she's not wrong. she also can't move — her mom's sick here.
ugh. yes. that's it. you're good at this, annoyingly.
